2317-6495-6763-7084.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending Dwarven Mine.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Dwarven Mine.
When Dwarven Mine dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning Dwarven Mine from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer
When Dwarven Mine enters, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Dwarf creature token.
Resolve the Evereth ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2317-6495-6763-7084.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-5147-5470-8201.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target
Repeat from step 2.

648-5239-5879.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is equal to or greater than the largest deck size among your opponents minus the number of +1/+1 counters on Walking Archive.
648-5239-5879.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to cause a creature to leave the battlefield.
648-5239-5879.description:
Cast Body of Research by paying {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U}, creating a 0/0 Fractal creature token and then putting a number of +1/+1 counters on it equal to your deck size.
Cause the Fractal to leave the battlefield by any method.
Enduring Bondwarden triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters onto Walking Archive equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on Fractal.
At the beginning of each opponent's upkeep, they will draw cards equal to the number of counters on Walking Archive. This should result in them drawing from an empty library either during their upkeep or their subsequent draw step, losing the game.

2034-5003-5482.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Sandstorm Salvager, adding {C}{C}.
When Sandstorm Salvager dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Sandstorm Salvager from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Sandstorm Salvager enters, it triggers, creating a creature token.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing a creature token, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

1742-5003-5231-7848.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three graveyards that each have seven or more cards in them.
1742-5003-5231-7848.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing The Master of Lake-town.
When The Master of Lake-town dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Master of Lake-town trigger, drawing a card for each graveyard that has seven or more cards in it.
Holding priority, activate Skirge Familiar by discarding a card, adding {B}.
Repeat step 4 two additional times.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return The Master of Lake-town from your graveyard to the battlefield and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.
1742-5003-5231-7848.notes: If your graveyard has six cards in it, you can count that as one of the graveyards with seven cards in it, as The Master of Lake-town will count as the seventh card.

1809-1987-3075.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1809-1987-3075.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two experience counters
1809-1987-3075.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1809-1987-3075.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

2103-3963-7722.notablePrerequisites: Meneldor cannot be blocked by an opponent.
2103-3963-7722.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost.
Thor's second ability triggers, dealing damage to any target.
Resolve Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one
Blink Thor using Meneldor.
When Thor enters, it triggers, exiling Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard and allowing you to cast it from exile until the end of your next turn.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Capture of Jingzhou from exile by paying its mana cost.
Repeat from step 2.

4499-6723-7296-7393.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking Niko.
When Niko enters, it triggers, creating two Shard tokens.
Activate Niko and the Shards by tapping them, adding {3}.
Repeat.

uses.n: The Legend of Kyoshi // Avatar Kyoshi

725-1432-7066.description:
Activate Avatar Kyoshi by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}
Activate Ioreth's second ability by tapping it, untapping Avatar Kyoshi and another legendary creature.
Activate Aura of Dominion by paying {1} and tapping the other legendary creature, untapping Ioreth.
Repeat.

618-3584-4456-7494.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, copying Blazing Firesinger. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Cast a copy of Seething Song by paying {2}{R}.
Thousand-Year Storm and Hematite Talisman trigger.
Resolve the Thousand-Year Storm trigger, copying Seething Song for each instant and sorcery cast before it this turn.
Resolve all copies of Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R} for each copy.
Resolve the Hematite Talisman trigger, causing you to pay {3} to untap Kiki-Jiki.
Resolve the original Seething Song, adding {R}{R}{R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.
618-3584-4456-7494.notes: If you've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn before starting the combo, the starting cost is reduced by {3}.

891-2292-2843.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Boonweaver Giant
When Boonweaver Giant dies, Unholy Indenture triggers, returning Boonweaver Giant from your graveyard to the battlefield
When Boonweaver Giant enters, it triggers, returning Unholy Indenture from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Boonweaver Giant.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4359-7353.easyPrerequisites: Opponents have at least two creature cards in their graveyards.
3259-4359-7353.notablePrerequisites: Opponents with creature cards in their graveyards cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4359-7353.description:
Deal combat damage using Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached. Shark Shredder and Breath of Fury trigger.
Resolve the Shark Shredder trigger, putting a creature card from the defending player's graveyard onto the battlefield under your control tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4359-7353.notes: If there happens to be two or more creatures with haste in opponents' graveyards, you can omit Garna so long as both Shark Shredder and the creature with Breath of Fury attached do not have summoning sickness.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1849-3259-7262.easyPrerequisites: There are creature cards in your library.
1849-3259-7262.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1849-3259-7262.description:
Declare Raph & Mikey and the creature with Breath of Fury attached as attackers.
Raph & Mikey triggers, revealing a creature card from your library and putting it onto the battlefield tapped and attacking.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature put onto the battlefield in step 2, and then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase until you have no creatures left in your library.
1849-3259-7262.notes: The number of combat phases you can get will be equal to the number of creature you control (excluding those listed in this combo) plus the number of creatures in your library plus 1.

1680-3767-3918-3941.description:
Activate Trazyn using Coveted Jewel's ability by tapping it, adding three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

186-2246-3657-6726.description:
Cast Ruby either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {0} due to Bard Class plus commander tax, if applicable.
Activate Ruby by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Kogla by paying {G}, returning Ruby from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
186-2246-3657-6726.notes: If Bard Class is level 3, you will also exile your library with the ability to play the exiled cards until end of turn.

1129-1323-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three Allies.
1129-1323-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Harabaz Druid's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

1287-2557-4918-6320.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block and kill Lightning Runner.
1287-2557-4918-6320.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Saheeli triggers, causing you to pay {E}{E}{E} to create two token copies of Aethertide Whale with haste.
When the Aethertide Whale tokens enter the battlefield, they trigger, causing you to get twelve {E}.
Declare Lightning Runner as an attacker, triggering its ability, causing you to get {E}{E} and then pay eight {E} to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

625-4853-4917-6429.notablePrerequisites: An opponent controls four or more nonbasic lands.
625-4853-4917-6429.description:
Activate Ashnod's Transmogrant by tapping and sacrificing it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing Razorlash Transmogrant.
When Razorlash Transmogrant dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Activate Razorlash Transmogrant by paying {B}{B}, putting it from your graveyard onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

2225-3767-3918-4851.easyPrerequisites: Trazyn the Infinite does not have summoning sickness.
2225-3767-3918-4851.description:
Activate Trazyn using Timeless Lotus's ability by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1308-4094-5658-6245.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You have the city's blessing or control at least six permanents.
1308-4094-5658-6245.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Satya as an attacker. Satya triggers, creating four token copies of Ocelot Pride that are tapped and attacking and causing you to get {E}{E}.
If you don't have the city's blessing, the Ocelot Pride token gives you the city's blessing.
At the beginning of your end step, Satya triggers four times, and each Ocelot Pride you control triggers once.
Resolve the first Ocelot Pride trigger, causing you to create three 1/1 Cat creature tokens if you gained life this turn, and then causing you to create three token copies of each creature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn, and then causing you to create a token copy of each noncreature token that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.
Repeat step 5 for each remaining trigger.
1308-4094-5658-6245.notes: You may repeat this loop during subsequent turns to get even more creature tokens and ETB triggers.

620-1636-3143.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one artifact creature token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a removable counter on a permanent you control.
620-1636-3143.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a copy of an artifact creature token you control.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Yotian Dissident trigger.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Yotian Dissident trigger, putting a counter on it.
Repeat.

4050-4365-5189-5439.notablePrerequisites: There is at least one removable +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
4050-4365-5189-5439.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating two 1/1 Saproling creature tokens.
Activate Adaptive Gemguard by tapping the Saprolings, putting a +1/+1 counter on Adaptive Gemguard.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing a Saproling, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1525-2031-2406-2660-3455.notablePrerequisites:
Vizier of Many Faces is a copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Wheel of Sun and Moon attached to you.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3455.description:
Cast Lightning Storm by paying {1}{R}{R}, targeting either copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Stormchaser Drake triggers, which due to Abundance causes you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a land card and put it into your hand.
Activate Lightning Storm by discarding a land card, putting that land card on the bottom of your library due to Wheel of Sun and Moon.
Resolve the Lightning Storm ability, putting two charge counters on it and changing the target to the other copy of Stormchaser Drake.
Repeat from step 2.
Once Lightning Storm has an arbitrarily large number of charge counters, activate it by discarding a land to change its target to any other target of your choosing to deal infinite damage to that target.
1525-2031-2406-2660-3455.notes: Other players may also activate Lightning Storm to change its target, making this combo risky if you do not have additional land cards in hand to activate Lightning Storm again.

86-307-2792.notablePrerequisites:
Mistblade Shinobi and Great Whale do not have summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block Mistblade Shinobi or Great Whale.
You control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
86-307-2792.description:
Declare Great Whale and Mistblade Shinobi as attackers.
When they aren't blocked, activate up to seven lands you control by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate Thousand-Faced Shadow's ninjutsu ability by paying {2}{U}{U} and returning Mistblade Shinobi from the battlefield to your hand, putting Thousand-Faced Shadow onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
When Thousand-Faced Shadow enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a token copy of Great Whale that is tapped and attacking.
When the Great Whale token enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping up to seven lands.
Activate Mistblade Shinobi's ninjutsu ability by paying {U} and returning Thousand-Faced Shadow from the battlefield to your hand, putting Mistblade Shinobi onto the battlefield from your hand tapped and attacking.
Repeat from step 2.
Deal combat damage using the Great Whale tokens, dealing infinite combat damage to the defending opponent.
If you control up to seven lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}{U}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana.

369-650-2292.notablePrerequisites: Unhallowed Pact attached to Iridescent Drake.
369-650-2292.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Iridescent Drake.
When Iridescent Drake dies, Unhallowed Pact triggers, returning Iridescent Drake from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Iridescent Drake enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Unhallowed Pact from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Iridescent Drake.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability from step 1, causing you to scry 1.
Repeat.

1418-1467-2103-3634.notablePrerequisites: You haven't copied a spell using Jin-Gitaxias this turn.
1418-1467-2103-3634.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying {3}{U}{U}.
Jin-Gitaxias triggers, copying Capture of Jingzhou.
Holding priority, cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, returning itself and the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand from the battlefield and stack respectively.
Resolve the copy of Capture of Jingzhou, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

326-2149.description:
Cast Chain of Smog by paying {1}{B}, targeting yourself.
Zaffai triggers, causing you to scry 1.
Resolve Chain of Smog, causing you to discard two cards and copy Chain of Smog, targeting yourself.
Repeat from step 2.

1240-1560-2290-3018.description:
Pay 2 life to cast Rancor targeting any creature.
Defiler of Vigor triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Remove a +1/+1 counter from Spike Feeder to activate it, gaining 2 life.
Resolve Rancor.
Sacrifice Rancor to Gatherer of Graces.
Rancor triggers, returning to your hand.
Resolve the Gatherer of Graces ability, regenerating it.
Repeat.

322-2657-2757-3129.notablePrerequisites:
You have a basic land card in hand.
You control a basic Forest.
322-2657-2757-3129.description:
Activate Ayula's Influence by discarding a basic land card, creating two 2/2 Bear creature tokens.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a Bear, untapping a basic Forest you control.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat from step 2 one additional time.
Activate Groundskeeper by paying {1}{G}, returning a basic land card from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

628-2034-4053.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional nontoken, non-Human creature that does not have a +1/+1 counter on it.
628-2034-4053.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the additional creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it to the battlefield from your graveyard with zero +1/+1 counters due to Solemnity.
Repeat.
